title: Meal Allowance — Domestic Travel
content: Employees travelling domestically on Acme Corp business are entitled to a meal allowance of $50 per day. This allowance covers breakfast, lunch and dinner combined. No itemised receipts are required for claims within the $50 per day limit. Claims above $50 per day require itemised receipts and manager approval. Alcohol is not reimbursable under this allowance. The allowance applies only on days when the employee is away from their primary work location for more than 6 hours on business.
